description: Search your Liked Songs (saved tracks) by text query and optional facets — client-side filter over a bounded walk of /me/tracks. For catalog-wide search use search. Reports walk truncation.

added_after.description: ISO date — only tracks added after this date

added_before.description: ISO date — only tracks added before this date

album.description: Filter to tracks where album name contains this substring

artist.description: Filter to tracks where any artist name contains this substring

max_items.description: How many saved tracks to walk (default SPOTIFY_MCP_FETCH_ALL_CAP)

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

query.description: Substring to match against track name, artist name, or album name (case-insensitive). Omit to list by facets/sort only.

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: search_saved_tracks
